title: TCAD Mesh Event
description: Schema for a single security event emitted by gateway or honeypot and ingested by control-api. ALL attacker-controlled string fields MUST be sanitized before population (Log Injection prevention).

id.description: UUID v4 generated by the emitter.

ts.description: RFC3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the event occurred.

event_type.description: Canonical event type. Allowed values are exhaustively listed.

mode.description: Operational mode that produced this event.

src_ip.description: Source IP address of the request. May be IPv4 or IPv6.

identity.description: Resolved identity: value of X-Device-ID header if present, otherwise Client IP. Sanitized.

session_id.description: Opaque session identifier assigned by gateway.

method.description: HTTP method of the triggering request.

path.description: Request path, truncated to 256 chars and sanitized (no raw newlines, control chars, or ANSI codes).

user_agent.description: User-Agent header value, truncated to 200 chars and sanitized.

status.description: HTTP status code returned to the client.

detail.description: Event-specific metadata. Structure varies per event_type. Optional.
